headline: Approved Nashua library contract amendments, including $2,180,155 for DesignLab, and accepted the schematic design.
summary: Presenters covered the library renovation's schedule, budget, design, and heating and cooling options. Schematic design was accepted, and two invoices and three contract amendments were approved, with Alderman Johnson opposed to each.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 28, 2026 meeting; motion carried.
Accepted the library schematic design as presented; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved DesignLab invoice #26-06.1026 for $213,526.25 for services through October 31, 2026; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved Consigli invoice 2 dated September 23, 2026 for $15,451.74; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved LeftField PM Amendment 1 for $581,224; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved DesignLab Architects Amendment 1 for $2,180,155; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved Consiglie Amendment 1 for $45,231; motion carried, with Alderman Johnson opposed.

plain_text:
JOINT MEETING – COMMITTEE ON INFRASTRUCTURE and 
LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
 
NOVEMBER 18, 2026 
 
A joint meeting of the Committee on Infrastructure and Library Board of Trustees was held Wednesday,  
November 18, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. in the aldermanic chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in 
accordance with the requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
The roll call was taken with 9 members of the Library Board of Trustees and Committee on Infrastructure present:   
 
 Alderman-at-Large Michael B. O’Brien, Sr. 
 Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg 
 Alderman Richard A. Dowd 
 Alderman Paula Johnson 
 Trustee Linda Laflamme 
  Trustee John Kennedy 
 Trustee Kristen Kane 
 Trustee Ernest A. Jette 
 Trustee Scott Jaquith 
      
Members not in Attendance: Alderwoman Vengerflutta Smith  
 Trustee Padmaja Kunapareddy 
 Trustee Patricia Dresner 
 Alderman-at-large Lori Wilshire 
 Mayor Jim Donchess 
  
Also in Attendance: Tim Cummings, Administrative Services Director 
 Kayla Gallo, LeftField 
 Ben Youtz 
 Jennifer McCormack, Library Director
